notices.title: Now Collecting In-Game Mail
lines: We are preparing to back up the mail received in the game.
If you still have mail saved, please send screenshots showing the "send date (including time)" and the "full text" through the feedback form or by email.
Mail from every server will be recorded, and other languages will be added as "fan translations."
Feel free to hide personal information such as your account name or UID.
We'd appreciate the help of all Professors. Thank you.

notices.title: Update v1.8.8 · Oasis Construction
lines: Added Oasis Construction under Game: upgrade materials, effects and requirements per level for Oasis and Sector buildings, plus the processing list (materials, time, unlocking story).
Effect cards now have borders, and doll chips only appear on effects unique to specific dolls.

notices.title: Update v1.8.7 · Achievements · Cloud Milestones
lines: Game now has "Achievements" (by category, with level rewards) and "Cloud Milestones" (tasks by module, with stage rewards).
Growth › Doll can now be picked by searching a name or nickname.

notices.title: Update v1.8.5 · Game › Growth
lines: Added a new "Game" category to the shortcuts and menu. "Growth" has Doll (material calculator) and Sprite (info · upgrade simulator) tabs. Sprites moved here from the Library.
Oasis Construction and more are coming soon.

notices.title: Update v1.8.4 · Function modes
lines: The Functions compendium now has a "Mode" row: Standard · Matrix · Entropic Survivor · Protocols · Function Chain · Warchess · Support. (First-pass grouping, to be refined after review.)

notices.title: Update v1.8.3 · Doll growth
lines: Doll pages now have a "Growth" tab: pick now → target for stars · level · Mind Expansion · skills · Arma Inscripta (on/off) to calculate the materials needed.
Each Library entry in the left menu can be expanded with ▶.

notices.title: Update v1.8.1 · Protocols
lines: The Effect Glossary now has a "Protocols" tab: filter by Favorable · Neutral · Unfavorable, split into base protocols and groups. (Group names and categories will be refined after review.)
The Library section of the left menu now lists Functions · Effect Glossary · Commander Skills · Sprites.

notices.title: Update v1.8.0 · Sprites
lines: The Library now has "Sprites": Sprite info (skill values by grade C · B · A · S, rank materials, stats by level) and an upgrade simulator (rank · level · skill rolls · materials used).
Commander skill Sprite variants now use the 4 Sprite skill grades (C · B · A · S).

notices.title: Update v1.7.10 · Exploration · Dungeon · Warchess Effects
lines: The Effect Glossary now has "Exploration Effects" · "Dungeon Effects" · "Warchess Effects" tabs (game mode buffs and debuffs, dots follow the icon color).

notices.title: Update v1.7.9 · Commander Skills · Tappable effects
lines: The Library now has "Commander Skills": 28 skills in 8 families (base · variants · Sprite variants), with Lv.1 / Lv.MAX values.
Tap an effect name (colored text or "「name」") in skill, Arma Inscripta or function text to see its description, then jump with "View in Effect Glossary".
Added 307 stat-boost functions to the Functions compendium (using the game's own wording).

notices.title: Update v1.7.8 · Effect Glossary · Functions
lines: The Library now has an "Effect Glossary": the descriptions shown when you tap an effect name in in-game skill text, grouped by in-game color (green · red · orange), plus Doll-Unique and Field · Tile Effects (terrain functions) tabs.

The Library now has a "Functions" compendium: browse by target (Guard · Sniper · Warrior …) or by set; the card border shows the in-game card color. Functions that differ only in numbers can be switched with the step buttons under the text.
Home: the birthday card shows today's or the next birthday, with the calendar under "Open calendar". Added the global server pickup schedule.
All Records is split into Main · Exclusive · Event · Other tabs, and Items into Souvenirs · Major Events · Event Rewards.
Skill icon frames and Arma Inscripta borders now match the game, with larger icons. Doll profiles show the in-game Doll number (#0410 etc.).

notices.title: Update v1.7 · Algorithms · Stats · All Records tabs
lines: The Library now has an "Algorithms" compendium: 40 sets in tabs by area, with 2-set · 3-set effects and expandable main · sub stat tables. There is also a "What are Algorithms?" guide.
Doll pages have a new "Stats" section: stats at initial rarity Lv.1 · 5★ Lv.60 · 5★ Lv.70, plus intimacy bonuses you can check by intimacy level.
Skills: turn on "Apply Arma Inscripta" to see enhanced skill names, an orange border and the added Ⅰ · Ⅱ · Ⅲ effects. Skill icon sizes now match the in-game screen.
The Doll list has a new "Arma Inscripta" filter.
All Records is now split into Main · Exclusive · Event · Other tabs. The last tab you viewed is remembered.
Doll profiles now show the same Doll number as the game (#0410 etc.).
Stat icons were added, and symbols such as stars, arrows and the hourglass are now image icons, so they look the same on every device.
A spinning indicator appears while images load.
Event items were moved into folders named after their event.

notices.title: Update v1.5 · Quick Access · Doll pages · Arma Inscripta
lines: The quick bar on the home screen is now "Quick Access": Home · All Records · Doll Records · Library. Main, Exclusive, Event and Other are chosen inside All Records.
"Library" opens a page with direct links to Perception's Record · Loading Tips · Items.
Doll pages now switch one section at a time from the contents at the top: Profile · Skills · Arma Inscripta · Intimacy · Voice · Outfits. Back returns to the previous section.
Arma Inscripta: the same look as the in-game screen. Change the level to see stat bonuses and the Ⅰ · Ⅱ · Ⅲ breakthrough skills.
Skill icons now use the in-game hexagon frame, colored by skill category. Furniture, profile frames and outfits inside boxes now have images too.
The search filter row now has an icon.
Doll stories can be expanded and collapsed one by one.
Undine's Arma Inscripta is a fan translation of the CN server text.
Loading Tips: added the "Magrasea Knowledge Base" category, and "Others" is now split into Companies · Factions · Other. Tips that mention a Doll now link to her profile.
Items: cards now show only the name and description; sources, gift preferences and contents open under "Details". Added a "Gifts" tab and sorted items from highest rarity.
Doll profiles and the Doll list now show class and role icons.

notices.title: About the 42LAB Record Archive
lines: Welcome to the 42LAB Record Archive, where all the stories and records of Girls' Frontline: Neural Cloud are gathered.
This is a fan-made site built through vibe coding. All rights belong to Sunborn Network Technology Co., Ltd. and MICA Team.
It contains every story and Doll profile from the global server, plus content that exists only on the CN server.
You can browse everything from in-game stories to Doll profiles and voice lines.
All text for the four Dolls with no text on the global server (Havoc, Olivia, Inola, ENIAC) was translated with Claude (AI).
Because of this, some characters' descriptions or speech may feel unnatural. Corrections and reports are welcome through the Google Form on the main page.
Most bug reports and questions can be sent through the Google Form.
For special inquiries, send an Ask or DM to @BPT2xNoa on X (formerly Twitter), and I will do my best to help.
Thank you.

notices.title: About the stories
lines: The Character Events of the three Dolls not released on the global server (Olivia, Inola, ENIAC) may have awkward sentences or incorrectly shown characters.
If you find any, please include the part name and the exact passage in the form when requesting a fix.
For the "Tutorial" and "Needs Review" scripts in the "Others" tab, feedback on where they belong and on corrections is always welcome.
These are parts I couldn't verify myself, so I'd be grateful if you could let me know through the feedback form.
Thank you.

notices.title: About Doll records
lines: The Doll profiles of the three Dolls not released on the global server (Olivia, Inola, ENIAC) may read unnaturally.
If you find any, please include the Doll's name and the passage in the form when requesting a fix.
We are aware that Havoc speaks in a regional dialect, but reviewing the dialect in the Korean version is difficult, so it is on hold for now.
Thank you.

notices.title: About UI/UX and features
lines: Feedback on UI/UX improvements and new features is always welcome.
Changes are made where possible, while keeping the site from getting too heavy.
Features related to illustrations or in-game information may be added to the menu in the future.
Features and updates are added without a fixed schedule, and updates are announced only in the notices on this site.

If you find awkward translations, stage directions shown as dialogue, or broken layouts, please let me know through the feedback form. Including the episode name and the sentence helps me fix it faster.
Thank you.

notices.title: Site guide · Copyright · Privacy
lines: The 42LAB Record Archive is an unofficial fan site that lets you reread the stories of Girls' Frontline: Neural Cloud like messenger chats.
It is a personal fan project unrelated to the game company, and it makes no money.
Story text is taken as-is from the game. Typos in the original may remain.
Read in English · 日本語 · 繁體中文 · 简体中文 · 한국어. Stories that exist only on the CN server are fan translations made with Claude (AI).
[Copyright]
All copyrights to the stories, characters, images and names of Girls' Frontline: Neural Cloud belong to their owners (Sunborn Network Technology Co., Ltd. / MICA Team).
The 42LAB Record Archive is an unofficial fan site unrelated to the game company and earns nothing.
Stories here are for reading and record keeping. Please do not copy, redistribute or use them commercially.
If the rights holders ask, the content will be taken down or the site closed immediately.
[Privacy]
There is no sign-up, and no personal data is collected.
Settings such as nickname, theme and reading position are stored only in your browser and are deleted with your browser data.
[Bug reports]
There are no individual replies. Fixes are announced in the notices on this site.
Typos in the original game text are kept as they are, so they may not be fixed right away.
